## Import

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(broom)
library(glue)
library(plotgardener)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(sjPlot)
library(gtools)
#setwd("~/gitcode/DNAm")
setwd("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/DNAm")
`%nin%` = negate(`%in%`) 
DATE = '20260224'
# DATE = ymd(Sys.Date()) %>% str_replace_all("-", "")

## Extract tidy results and standardized coefficents
get_std_res <- function(model) {
    std_res <- standardize_parameters(model, method = "refit") %>% as_tibble()

    if (inherits(model, "merMod")) {
        res <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") 
     } else {                                  # anything that is not merMod
        res <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = T) 
    }

    return(left_join(res, std_res, by = c('term' = 'Parameter')))
}

```


```{r}
## Import 
#| include: false 

adni <- read_csv(glue('intermediate/adni_{DATE}.csv')) %>%
  mutate(

  )

cog.df <- adni %>% 
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice_min(PHC_Visit) %>%
  ungroup()

mri.df <- read_csv(glue('intermediate/mri_{DATE}.csv')) %>%
 mutate(
   apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3"), 
   educ_cat = fct_relevel(educ_cat, 'HighSchool')
 )

flbm.df <- read_csv(glue('intermediate/flbm_{DATE}.csv')) %>%
 mutate(
   apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3"), 
   educ_cat = fct_relevel(educ_cat, 'HighSchool')
 )

adni %>% 
  select(RID, gbl_cog, yrs_c, nk_cell, z_dnam_bl)
names(adni)
table(adni$htn, useNA = "ifany")
summary(adni$bmi)
table(adni$obesity, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Analysis
### Global Cognition 
#### Baseline Models
```{r}
fitlmer.00 <- lmer(gbl_cog ~ yrs_c + (yrs_c  | RID), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.00)

cog_bl_cov <- "yrs_c + z_age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl + apoe + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

fitlmer.01 <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bl_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)")), 
                  REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.01)

fitlmer.02a <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02a) 

fitlmer.02b <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02b)

fitlmer.02c <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_mtcn_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02c)
```

```{r}
cog_bllm_cov <- "z_age_bl + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl + apoe + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl + causage_bl + tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl * causage_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl + causage_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl * causage_bl + tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  causage_bl + mtcn_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()

```

#### Longitudinal
```{r}

cog_lt_cov <- "yrs_c + z_age_bl*yrs_c + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl*yrs_c + apoe*yrs_c + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

## Longitudional
fitlmer.03 <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03)

fitlmer.03a <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03a)
plot_model(fitlmer.03a, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_tl_bl"))

fitlmer.03b <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03b)
plot_model(fitlmer.03b, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_dnam_bl"))

fitlmer.03c <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03c)
plot_model(fitlmer.03c, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))

fitlmer.03d <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl*yrs_c + z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03d)

plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_tl_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_dnam_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))
```

```{r}

gbl_cog_bioage.res <- bind_rows(
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "baseline"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03a) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "TL"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03b) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "CausAge"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03c) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "mtDNAcn"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03d) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "BioAge")
  ) %>%
  relocate(outcome, model) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = signif(estimate, 2),
    std.error = signif(std.error, 2),
    p.value_fmt = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),              
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}{sig}")
  ) 
  
gbl_cog_bioage.res  %>% 
  print(n = Inf)

```

```{r}

summary(fitlmer.04b); car::vif(fitlmer.04b)
plot_model(fitlmer.04b, type = "pred", terms = c("z_mtcn_bl", "z_tl_bl"))


fitlmer.04c <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl*z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)

fitlmer.04d <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_mtcn_bl*z_tl_bl*z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
```

```{r}

gbl_cog_x.res <- bind_rows(

) %>%

      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),              # decimal (3 places)
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),      
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}")
  ) 
  
gbl_cog_x.res  %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```

### Cogntive Domains
#### Episodic Memory
```{r}

cog_lt_cov <- "yrs_c + z_age_bl*yrs_c + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl*yrs_c + apoe*yrs_c + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

## Longitudional
fitlmer.mem_tl <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_tl_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_dnam <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_mtcn <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_bioag <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_tl_bl*yrs_c + z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

summary(fitlmer.mem_bioag)
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_tl_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_dnam_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))

## DNAm x mtCN
fitlmer.mem_dnam_mtcn <- lmer(glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_mtcn_bl*z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni
  )
summary(fitlmer.mem_dnam_mtcn )

  )
```

```{r}
mem.res <- bind_rows(
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_tl) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "TL", predictor = 'TL'),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_mtcn) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcn", predictor = 'mtDNAcn'),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_dnam) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "CausAge", predictor = 'CausAge'),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_bioag) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "BioAge"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_dnam_tl) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "DNAmxTL"), 
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_tl_mtcn) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcnxTL"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_dnam_mtcn) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAm"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_bioag_x ) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL"),
) %>% 
  mutate(
    estimate = signif(estimate, 2),
    std.error = signif(std.error, 2),
    p.value_fmt = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),              # decimal (3 places)
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),      
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}")
  ) 
  
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    estimate = signif(estimate, 2),
    std.error = signif(std.error, 2),
    p.value_fmt = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),              # decimal (3 places)
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),      
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}")
  ) 
  
```

```{r}
csf_coef.p <- csf.res %>%
  filter(term %in% c('z_mtcn', 'z_dnam', 'z_tl')) %>%

  ggplot(., aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +

  labs(
    x = "Coefficient Estimate (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
```

# multiple-testing
```{r}
# multiple-testing --------------------------------------------------------
# Bonferroni within outcome domains (family-wise):
#   CSF: 3 outcomes x 7 predictors = 21 tests
#   MRI: 2 outcomes x 7 predictors = 14 tests
#   Baseline Cog: 5 outcomes x 7 predictors = 35 tests
#   Longitudinal Cog: 5 outcomes x 7 predictors = 35 tests
#
# Bonferroni-adjusted p per test:
#   p_bonf = min(p.value * m, 1)

alpha <- 0.05

bonf_terms <- c(
  "TL","DNAm","mtDNAcn",
  "DNAmxTL","mtDNAcnxTL","mtDNAcnxDNAm","mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL"
)

# 1) family variable (domain)
res.df <- res.df %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_bonf = case_when(
      str_detect(endophenotype, regex("Baseline", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ paste0("Baseline_", outcome),
      str_detect(endophenotype, regex("Longitudinal", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ paste0("Longitudinal_", outcome),
      TRUE ~ outcome
    ),
    bonf_family = case_when(
      str_detect(endophenotype, regex("Cog", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Cognition",
      str_detect(endophenotype, regex("CSF", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "CSF",
      str_detect(endophenotype, regex("MRI", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "MRI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(endophenotype)
    )
  )

res.df %>%
  group_by(bonf_family) %>%
  summarise(
    n_outcomes = n_distinct(outcome),
    outcomes = paste(unique(outcome), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()
# 2) remove exact duplicates BEFORE counting outcomes/tests
res.df <- res.df %>%
  distinct(bonf_family, outcome, model, term, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 3) compute m per family = (# unique outcomes in that family) * (# predictors/terms)
bonf_info <- res.df %>%
  filter(term %in% bonf_terms) %>%
  group_by(bonf_family) %>%
  summarise(
    n_outcomes = n_distinct(outcome),
    m = n_outcomes * length(bonf_terms),
    alpha_bonf = alpha / m,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(bonf_info)

# 4) apply Bonferroni per test
res.df <- res.df %>%
  left_join(bonf_info %>% select(bonf_family, m, alpha_bonf), by = "bonf_family") %>%
  group_by(bonf_family) %>%
  mutate(
    p_bonf = if_else(
      term %in% bonf_terms,
      p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),   # now per family because grouped
      NA_real_
    ),
    sig_bonf = if_else(term %in% bonf_terms, p_bonf < alpha_bonf, NA)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 5) sanity checks (optional but useful)
res.df %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_has_m = sum(!is.na(m)),
    n_has_p_bonf = sum(!is.na(p_bonf)),
    min_p = min(p.value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_p_bonf = min(p_bonf, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% print()

res.df %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_bonf)) %>%
  arrange(p_bonf) %>%
  select(endophenotype, outcome, model, term, p.value, m, p_bonf) %>%
  print(n = 20)

# 6) table that includes Bonferroni-adjusted p-values
res.df %>%
  select(endophenotype, model, outcome, term,
         Std_Coefficient, CI_low, CI_high,
         p.value, p_bonf) %>%
  write_csv(glue("results/all_results_{DATE}_with_bonf.csv"), na = "")
```

# Sensitivity
```{r}
#| eval: !isFALSE(getOption("run_sens", FALSE))
# Sensitivity
# ============================================================
# Sensitivity: cardiometabolic adjustment (BMI + HTN)
# Mirrors PRIMARY model grid (TL-only, DNAm-only, mtDNAcn-only,
# Joint, 2-way interactions, 3-way) + adds bmi + htn
# Collect tidy outputs + export supplementary CSV + Excel
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(easystats)
library(purrr)
library(openxlsx)


# helpers

paste_cov <- function(x) paste(x, collapse = " + ")
adni <- adni %>%
  left_join(bmi_htn_by_rid, by = "RID")
collect_model <- function(model, domain, outcome, analysis, model_label) {

  td <- if (inherits(model, "merMod")) {
    broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)
  } else {
    broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)
  }

  std <- tryCatch({
    sp <- easystats::standardize_parameters(model, method = "refit") %>% as_tibble()

    # robust-ish mapping across easystats versions
    sp %>%
      transmute(
        term = .data$Parameter,
        Std_Coefficient = .data$Std_Coefficient,
        CI_low  = dplyr::coalesce(.data$CI_low,  .data$CI_low.Std_Coefficient,  NA_real_),
        CI_high = dplyr::coalesce(.data$CI_high, .data$CI_high.Std_Coefficient, NA_real_)
      )
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(
      term = td$term,
      Std_Coefficient = NA_real_,
      CI_low = NA_real_,
      CI_high = NA_real_
    )
  })

  td %>%
    left_join(std, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(
      domain = domain,
      outcome = outcome,
      analysis = analysis,
      model_label = model_label
    ) %>%
    relocate(domain, outcome, analysis, model_label)
}


# 1) Outcomes

outcomes_cog <- c("gbl_cog", "PHC_MEM", "PHC_EXF", "PHC_LAN", "PHC_VSP")
csf_outcomes  <- c("PHC_AB42", "PHC_Tau", "PHC_pTau")
mri_outcomes  <- c("cort_thk_volwt", "gm_vol")


# 2) Covariates (PRIMARY + bmi + htn)

cells_bl  <- c("nk_cell_bl","b_cell_bl","cd4_t_cell_bl","cd8_t_cell_bl","monocyte_bl")
cells_csf <- c("nk_cell","b_cell","cd4_t_cell","cd8_t_cell","monocyte")

cog_base_cov_sens <- c(
  "z_age_bl","sex","educ_cat","cdrsb_bl","apoe",
  cells_bl,
  "bmi","htn"
)

# IMPORTANT: do NOT include yrs_c here because marker parts will add it
cog_lt_cov_terms_sens <- c(
  "z_age_bl", "z_age_bl:yrs_c",
  "sex",
  "educ_cat",
  "cdrsb_bl", "cdrsb_bl:yrs_c",
  "apoe", "apoe:yrs_c",
  cells_bl,
  "bmi", "htn"
)

csf_cov_sens <- c("age","sex","cdrsb","apoe", cells_csf, "bmi","htn")

mri_cov_sens <- c("age_bl","sex","cdrsb_bl","apoe","months", cells_bl, "bmi","htn")
mri_cov_gm_sens <- c(mri_cov_sens, "EstimatedTotalIntraCranialVol_combat")


# 3) Model grid (mirrors PRIMARY)

model_specs_bl <- list(
  TL_only     = "z_tl_bl",
  DNAm_only   = "z_dnam_bl",
  mtDNAcn_only= "z_mtcn_bl",
  Joint       = "z_tl_bl + z_dnam_bl + z_mtcn_bl",
  TL_x_DNAm   = "z_tl_bl * z_dnam_bl",
  TL_x_mtDNA  = "z_tl_bl * z_mtcn_bl",
  DNAm_x_mtDNA= "z_dnam_bl * z_mtcn_bl",
  Three_way   = "z_mtcn_bl * z_tl_bl * z_dnam_bl"
)

# for longitudinal, always include time and marker*time
model_specs_lt <- list(
  TL_only      = "yrs_c + z_tl_bl*yrs_c",
  DNAm_only    = "yrs_c + z_dnam_bl*yrs_c",
  mtDNAcn_only = "yrs_c + z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c",
  Joint        = "yrs_c + z_tl_bl*yrs_c + z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c",
  TL_x_DNAm    = "yrs_c + (z_tl_bl * z_dnam_bl) * yrs_c",
  TL_x_mtDNA   = "yrs_c + (z_tl_bl * z_mtcn_bl) * yrs_c",
  DNAm_x_mtDNA = "yrs_c + (z_dnam_bl * z_mtcn_bl) * yrs_c",
  Three_way    = "yrs_c + (z_mtcn_bl * z_tl_bl * z_dnam_bl) * yrs_c"
)

# CSF uses non-_bl marker names 
model_specs_csf <- list(
  TL_only      = "z_tl",
  DNAm_only    = "z_dnam",
  mtDNAcn_only = "z_mtcn",
  Joint        = "z_tl + z_dnam + z_mtcn",
  TL_x_DNAm    = "z_tl * z_dnam",
  TL_x_mtDNA   = "z_tl * z_mtcn",
  DNAm_x_mtDNA = "z_dnam * z_mtcn",
  Three_way    = "z_mtcn * z_tl * z_dnam"
)

# MRI uses _bl marker names
model_specs_mri <- model_specs_bl


# 4) Cohort-specific sensitivity datasets

adni_sens <- adni %>%
  filter(!is.na(bmi), !is.na(htn))

# baseline row per RID: UPDATE to match baseline definition
bmi_htn_by_rid <- adni %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice_min(PHC_Visit, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  select(RID, bmi, htn)

mri_sens.df <- mri.df %>%
  left_join(bmi_htn_by_rid, by = "RID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(bmi), !is.na(htn))

flbm_sens.df <- flbm.df %>%
  left_join(bmi_htn_by_rid, by = "RID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(bmi), !is.na(htn))


# 5) Fit sensitivity models (full grid)


# 5A) Cognition baseline LMs (all outcomes x all specs)
lm_sens_cog <- crossing(outcome = outcomes_cog, spec = names(model_specs_bl)) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map2(outcome, spec, ~{
      marker_part <- model_specs_bl[[.y]]
      fml <- as.formula(paste0(.x, " ~ ", marker_part, " + ", paste_cov(cog_base_cov_sens)))
      lm(fml, data = adni_sens)
    })
  )

# 5B) Cognition longitudinal LMMs (all outcomes x all specs)
lmer_sens_cog <- crossing(outcome = outcomes_cog, spec = names(model_specs_lt)) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map2(outcome, spec, ~{
      marker_part <- model_specs_lt[[.y]]
      fml <- as.formula(paste0(
        .x, " ~ ",
        marker_part, " + ",
        paste_cov(cog_lt_cov_terms_sens), " + ",
        "(1 + yrs_c | RID)"
      ))
      lmer(
        fml,
        data = adni_sens,
        REML = FALSE,
        control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead")
      )
    })
  )

# 5C) CSF LMs (all outcomes x all specs)
lm_sens_csf <- crossing(outcome = csf_outcomes, spec = names(model_specs_csf)) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map2(outcome, spec, ~{
      marker_part <- model_specs_csf[[.y]]
      fml <- as.formula(paste0(.x, " ~ ", marker_part, " + ", paste_cov(csf_cov_sens)))
      lm(fml, data = flbm_sens.df)
    })
  )

# 5D) MRI LMs (each outcome x all specs; handle GM ICV cov)
lm_sens_mri <- crossing(outcome = mri_outcomes, spec = names(model_specs_mri)) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map2(outcome, spec, ~{
      marker_part <- model_specs_mri[[.y]]
      covs <- if (.x == "gm_vol") mri_cov_gm_sens else mri_cov_sens
      fml <- as.formula(paste0(.x, " ~ ", marker_part, " + ", paste_cov(covs)))
      lm(fml, data = mri_sens.df)
    })
  )


# 6) Collect results

sens_all <- bind_rows(
  pmap_dfr(list(lm_sens_cog$model, lm_sens_cog$outcome, lm_sens_cog$spec),
           ~collect_model(..1, "Cognition", ..2, "baseline_LM", ..3)),
  pmap_dfr(list(lmer_sens_cog$model, lmer_sens_cog$outcome, lmer_sens_cog$spec),
           ~collect_model(..1, "Cognition", ..2, "longitudinal_LMM", ..3)),
  pmap_dfr(list(lm_sens_csf$model, lm_sens_csf$outcome, lm_sens_csf$spec),
           ~collect_model(..1, "CSF", ..2, "baseline_LM", ..3)),
  pmap_dfr(list(lm_sens_mri$model, lm_sens_mri$outcome, lm_sens_mri$spec),
           ~collect_model(..1, "MRI", ..2, "baseline_LM", ..3))
) %>%
  relocate(domain, outcome, analysis, model_label)




# 7) Export Supplementary CSV (unstandardized estimates)

# normalize interaction terms so a:b and b:a become identical
norm_term <- function(t) {
  if (!grepl(":", t, fixed = TRUE)) return(t)
  parts <- strsplit(t, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  paste(sort(parts), collapse=":")
}

sens_supp <- sens_all %>%
  mutate(
    # keep original if you want it
    term_raw = term,

    # normalized term used everywhere downstream
    term = vapply(term, norm_term, character(1)),

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  select(domain, outcome, analysis, model_label,
         term, term_raw,
         estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value,
         conf.low, conf.high, sig)

write_csv(sens_supp, glue("results/sensitivity_cardiometabolic_{DATE}.csv"), na = "")

```

```{r}
model_order <- c(
  "TL","CausAge","mtDNAcn","Joint",
  "mtDNAcn x TL","mtDNAcn x DNAm","DNAm x TL",
  "mtDNAcn x DNAm x TL"
)
marker_terms <- c(
  "TL",
  "DNAm",
  "mtDNAcn",
  "DNAm x TL",
  "mtDNAcn x TL",
  "DNAm x mtDNAcn",
  "DNAm x mtDNAcn x TL"
)

baseline_terms <- c(
  "(Intercept)","z_age_bl","age","sex",
  "educ_catHighSchool","educ_catCollege","educ_catGraduate","educ_cat",
  "cdrsb_bl","cdrsb", "sexMale",
"apoee2+","apoee4+",
  "bmi","htn",
  "nk_cell_bl","b_cell_bl","cd4_t_cell_bl","cd8_t_cell_bl","monocyte_bl",
  "z_tl_bl","z_dnam_bl","z_mtcn_bl",
  "z_dnam_bl:z_tl_bl","z_mtcn_bl:z_tl_bl","z_dnam_bl:z_mtcn_bl",
  "z_dnam_bl:z_mtcn_bl:z_tl_bl"
)

long_terms <- c(
  "yrs_c","months",
  "z_age_bl","age","cdrsb_bl","cdrsb","apoee2+","apoee4+",
"apoee2+:yrs_c","apoee4+:yrs_c",
  "bmi","htn",
  "z_tl_bl","z_dnam_bl","z_mtcn_bl",
  "z_dnam_bl:z_tl_bl","z_mtcn_bl:z_tl_bl","z_dnam_bl:z_mtcn_bl",
  "z_dnam_bl:z_mtcn_bl:z_tl_bl"
)
unique(sens_supp$term) %>% sort()

table_sens <- sens_supp %>%
  filter(term %in% names(term_keep)) %>%
  mutate(
    analysis = recode(analysis,
      baseline_LM = "Baseline",
      longitudinal_LMM = "Longitudinal"
    ),
    outcome = recode(outcome,
      gbl_cog = "Global Cognition",
      PHC_MEM = "Memory",
      PHC_EXF = "Executive Function",
      PHC_LAN = "Language",
      PHC_VSP = "Visual Spatial Function",
      PHC_AB42 = "AB42",
      PHC_Tau = "Tau",
      PHC_pTau = "pTau",
      cort_thk_volwt = "Cortical Thickness",
      gm_vol = "Gray Matter Volume"
    ),
    Model = recode(model_label,
      TL_only = "TL",
      DNAm_only = "CausAge",
      mtDNAcn_only = "mtDNAcn",
      Joint = "Joint",
      TL_x_DNAm = "DNAm x TL",
      TL_x_mtDNA = "mtDNAcn x TL",
      DNAm_x_mtDNA = "mtDNAcn x DNAm",
      Three_way = "mtDNAcn x DNAm x TL"
    ),
    # if sens_supp already has sig you can use it, but safe to recompute:
    sig2 = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    P = paste0(formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2), " ", sig2)
  ) %>%
  select(domain, outcome, analysis, term, Model,
         Estimate = estimate, SE = std.error, P)

make_wide <- function(df, model_order) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(term = recode(term, !!!term_keep))

  wide <- df %>%
    select(term, Model, Estimate, SE, P) %>%
    mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = model_order)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Model,
      values_from = c(Estimate, SE, P),
      names_glue = "{Model}_{.value}"
    )

  ordered_cols <- c(
    "term",
    unlist(lapply(model_order, function(m) {
      c(paste0(m, "_Estimate"), paste0(m, "_SE"), paste0(m, "_P"))
    }))
  )
  wide %>% select(any_of(ordered_cols))
}

write_with_merged_headers <- function(wb, sheet_name, df, model_order) {

  writeData(wb, sheet_name, df, startRow = 3, colNames = FALSE)

  header_top <- c("Term")
  header_second <- c("")

  for (m in model_order) {
    header_top <- c(header_top, m, rep("", 2))
    header_second <- c(header_second, "Estimate", "SE", "P")
  }

  writeData(wb, sheet_name, t(as.data.frame(header_top)), startRow = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, t(as.data.frame(header_second)), startRow = 2, colNames = FALSE)

  start_col <- 2
  for (i in seq_along(model_order)) {
    mergeCells(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = start_col:(start_col+2), rows = 1)
    start_col <- start_col + 3
  }

  header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center")
  addStyle(wb, sheet_name, header_style,
           rows = 1:2, cols = 1:(1 + length(model_order)*3),
           gridExpand = TRUE)


  bold_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")

  data_start_row <- 3
  data_end_row <- data_start_row + nrow(df) - 1

  # Identify Estimate columns
  estimate_cols <- seq(2, by = 3, length.out = length(model_order))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

    term_label <- df$term[i]

    if (term_label %in% marker_terms) {

      row_excel <- data_start_row + i - 1

      for (j in seq_along(estimate_cols)) {

        p_col <- estimate_cols[j] + 2  # P column is 2 columns after Estimate
        est_col <- estimate_cols[j]

        p_value_string <- df[i, p_col]

        if (!is.na(p_value_string) && grepl("\\*", p_value_string)) {
          addStyle(wb, sheet_name,
                   bold_style,
                   rows = row_excel,
                   cols = est_col,
                   gridExpand = FALSE)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

make_one_outcome_sheet <- function(table_sens, outcome_name, baseline_terms, long_terms, model_order) {

  df_out <- table_sens %>% filter(outcome == outcome_name)

  base_block <- df_out %>%
    filter(analysis == "Baseline", term %in% baseline_terms) %>%
    mutate(term = factor(term, levels = baseline_terms)) %>%
    arrange(term) %>%
    make_wide(model_order)

  long_block <- df_out %>%
    filter(analysis == "Longitudinal", term %in% long_terms) %>%
    mutate(term = factor(term, levels = long_terms)) %>%
    arrange(term) %>%
    make_wide(model_order)

  bind_rows(
    tibble(term = "Baseline"),
    base_block,
    tibble(term = "Longitudinal"),
    long_block
  )
}

make_domain_multi_outcome_sheet <- function(table_sens, domain_name, outcomes_in_order, model_order) {
  df_domain <- table_sens %>% filter(domain == domain_name)

  bind_rows(lapply(outcomes_in_order, function(oo) {
    block <- df_domain %>%
      filter(outcome == oo) %>%
      make_wide(model_order)

    bind_rows(tibble(term = oo), block)
  }))
}


wb <- createWorkbook()

cog_outcomes <- c("Global Cognition","Memory","Executive Function","Language","Visual Spatial Function")
for (oo in cog_outcomes) {
  addWorksheet(wb, oo)
  sheet_df <- make_one_outcome_sheet(table_sens, oo, baseline_terms, long_terms, model_order)
  write_with_merged_headers(wb, oo, sheet_df, model_order)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "CSF")
csf_sheet <- make_domain_multi_outcome_sheet(table_sens, "CSF", c("AB42","Tau","pTau"), model_order)
write_with_merged_headers(wb, "CSF", csf_sheet, model_order)

addWorksheet(wb, "MRI")
mri_sheet <- make_domain_multi_outcome_sheet(table_sens, "MRI", c("Cortical Thickness","Gray Matter Volume"), model_order)
write_with_merged_headers(wb, "MRI", mri_sheet, model_order)

saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0("results/SupplementaryTables_", DATE, ".xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
setdiff(sort(unique(sens_supp$term)), sort(names(term_keep)))
setdiff(sort(names(term_keep)), sort(unique(sens_supp$term)))
names(adni)
```

#Power Calculations

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(simr)

adni$sex <- factor(adni$sex)

#all data mixed model 
fit <- lmer(
  gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl * z_mtcn_bl * yrs_c +
    z_age_bl + sex + cdrsb_bl + apoe_e4 +
    (1 + yrs_c | RID),
  data = adni,
  REML = FALSE
)


fit_sim <- fit
fixef(fit_sim)["z_tl_bl:yrs_c"] <- 0.05

# sex-stratified models
fit_m <- lmer(
  gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl * z_mtcn_bl * yrs_c +
    z_age_bl + cdrsb_bl + apoe_e4 +
    (1 + yrs_c | RID),
  data = subset(adni, sex == "Male"),
  REML = FALSE
)

fit_f <- lmer(
  gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl * z_mtcn_bl * yrs_c +
    z_age_bl + cdrsb_bl + apoe_e4 +
    (1 + yrs_c | RID),
  data = subset(adni, sex == "Female"),
  REML = FALSE
)

# assumed effect size in each stratified model
fixef(fit_m)["z_tl_bl:yrs_c"] <- 0.05
fixef(fit_f)["z_tl_bl:yrs_c"] <- 0.05

set.seed(101)
powerSim(fit_m, fixed("z_tl_bl:yrs_c", "t"), nsim = 200)

set.seed(102)
powerSim(fit_f, fixed("z_tl_bl:yrs_c", "t"), nsim = 200)

fit_full <- fit
fixef(fit_full)["z_tl_bl:yrs_c"] <- 0.05

set.seed(200)
powerSim(fit_full, fixed("z_tl_bl:yrs_c", "t"), nsim = 200)
```

```{r}
    participants_missing_bmi = sum(!has_bmi),
    participants_missing_htn = sum(!has_htn),
    participants_missing_either = sum(!(has_bmi & has_htn)),
    participants_complete_both = sum(has_bmi & has_htn)
  )

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  summarise(

    n_missing_either = sum(!(has_bmi & has_htn))
```
